$comment: Fapte despre aplicația Lento.fit, folosite de documentația din docs/lento-fit/ și de unealta `about` a serverului MCP. Sursa: pagina publică https://lento.fit/llms.txt și echipa Lento.fit. Lento.fit este un produs separat de acest proiect open-source.
product_type: mobile app (iPhone, Android); AI nutrition assistant and food journal
relationship_to_this_repository: Same team (Netwise Media SRL). `calorii` is a separate open-source project: engine, dataset, site, MCP server, widget. Lento.fit is not open source and does not use `alimente-ro`; `calorii` has no photo recognition.

platforms.ios: iPhone, iOS 15.1 or later (runs as an iPhone app on iPad)

photo_logging.what_it_does: recognises the dishes in the photo, estimates portion weight, calories, protein, carbohydrates, fat, fibre and micronutrients
photo_logging.result_marking: estimate, with a confidence range, not a single falsely precise number
photo_logging.correction: every line can be corrected: different food, more, less
photo_logging.after_logging: the meal enters the day view and the remaining plan of the day is recalculated

pro.price: shown in the app store; varies by country

plans.on_signup: one day of Pro without a card; the first photo is free

not: a medical device (numbers are estimates, not medical advice)
a web app (no browser or desktop version)
a shame-based tracker (the streak forgives a missed day; no forbidden foods)
privacy: explicit consent before a photo or text is sent to the AI (reversible in Settings)
